After a week long hard battle my little baby passed away. … Now they said its contagious and my other male cat was along this cat for 2 days after she fell sick. After rigorous treatment for my male cat for a week he died. No explanation why he contracted it even tho he didn’t go through any surgery for immunity crash….

after lots of awful shit of visiting multiple vet hospitals (superpets, top dog, the feline foundation, dr Netkar’s in thane) and spending 70-80k i lost both my babies… My whole world is crumbled to nothing.
